name: Wallace Electronics Inc
old_description: Wallace Electronics is a Woman Owned Manufacturer of Custom Cable Assemblies and Electronic Enclosures. Located in Dallas, Texas, we have been providing our goods and services to the Electronics Industry since 1977.
about:
Founded in 1977 in Dallas, Texas, Wallace Electronics is a woman-owned manufacturer of custom cable assemblies and electronic enclosures. The company has served the electronics industry for over four decades from its facility on Miller Road.

The company designs and manufactures custom cable assemblies, wiring harnesses, and electronic enclosures. Its capabilities include custom fabrication, in-house overmolding, custom shielding and pinout design, reverse engineering from samples, and engineering support from prototype through scaled production. Wallace works with wire gauges from 30 AWG to 2/0 using materials such as PVC, silicone, and Teflon, and maintains over 300 applicators for precision terminations. The facility also provides continuity testing, pull tests, electrical validation, and environmental testing for vibration and temperature extremes.

Wallace serves a broad range of industries, including industrial automation, military, medical, automotive, aerospace, transportation (bus and rail), renewable energy (solar and wind), telecommunications, security, oil and gas, and food and beverage. Its customers are primarily OEMs and contract manufacturers that require custom cable solutions for specialized equipment and harsh environments.

The company emphasizes flexibility and partnership, offering connector-agnostic designs, design-for-manufacturability consulting, stocking programs, drop-shipping, and blanket orders to simplify supply chains. Quality is backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification, UL approval for wiring harnesses, and compliance with RoHS, REACH, DFARS/ITAR, and conflict minerals requirements. As a woman-owned business, Wallace highlights diversity and leadership in manufacturing.
